title: Media library
summary: Use this page to review stored media and decide what can safely stay, be marked for cleanup, or be removed.

sections.title: Filters
sections.markdown:
- **Search** finds media by filename, alt text, media ID, or metadata.
- **Owner**, **Type**, **Upload association**, **Usage**, and **Review** narrow the list when you are checking a smaller set of files.

sections.title: Statuses
sections.markdown:
- **In use** means the file has a known current reference.
- **Possibly unused** means no current use was found.
- **Upload association only** means the file was attached to an upload flow, but no current use was verified.
- Reference counts show how many known places use the file.
- **Unreviewed**, **Reviewed: keep**, and **Cleanup candidate** are review notes you set while working through the list.

sections.title: Actions
sections.markdown:
- **Details** shows file, metadata, and usage information.
- **Keep** marks a file as reviewed and worth keeping.
- **Cleanup candidate** marks a file for possible removal.
- **Clear** removes the review note.
- **Delete permanently** removes the file when it is allowed.

sections.title: Safe cleanup
sections.markdown: **Delete permanently** should only appear for cleanup candidates. Before deleting, open **Details** and check the usage information. Deletion is still checked on the server before it happens, and permanent deletion cannot be undone.
